summary.name: PowerPresent
summary.one_liner: PowerPresent is an AI presentation maker that builds slide decks from a prompt, document, notes, or template and exports them to PowerPoint.
use_cases: Turning a document or notes into a slide deck
Generating a presentation from a text prompt
Building charts and diagrams for a business talk
Creating a PowerPoint file to share or present
Presenting slides online to an audience
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI tool that creates a presentation from a prompt, pasted notes, a document, or an existing template, then lets the user edit each slide. Slides can be presented online or exported to PowerPoint, with PDF export also offered on the free tier (watermarked). It mentions editable charts and diagrams for numbers and ideas, and imagery placed to support the message. Pricing is split between a free tier, pay-per-credit purchases, monthly and yearly subscriptions, a one-time lifetime payment, and a custom team plan. Source-file upload limits and support levels vary by plan.
notable: Creates a narrative structure from source material, with each slide building on the last
Exports to PowerPoint; free tier allows watermarked PDF export
Pricing options include pay-per-credit, monthly/yearly subscriptions, a $499 lifetime plan, and team plans
caveats: Free tier exports are watermarked PDFs, and premium AI and media tools require a paid plan
Watermark-free output and public sharing require paid credits or plans
Source-file uploads are limited to 1MB on free and pay-as-you-go, 10MB on higher tiers
Listed as paid in the hanishrao/collective-ai-tools directory
